column7: The DEK, KEK salt and TLS private key (enforceKeyFilePermissions), --passphrase-file and the file KEK provider judged the mode only, so a 0600 file owned by another unprivileged account (which can rewrite it) passed. They now apply secretenv.CheckOwner (running euid or root): refused under an explicit or implicit-default enable_file_permission_check (TLS keys warn on the implicit default), warned under the ADR-112 grace / check off / insecure_allow_unsafe_file_permissions; --passphrase-file and the file KEK are refused unconditionally. Also TestReadPassphraseFile_Owner, TestFileKeyProvider_Owner (internal/crypto/passphrase_owner_test.go) and the class guard TestModeChecksAlsoJudgeTheOwner (internal/secretenv/owner_guard_test.go).
